best_idea: Drive the walk cycle from distance travelled (one cycle per stride) and layer the pose as base set, one locomotion clip added, and a swing clip added on its own channel, so the gait needs no render clock.
decision_why: Frankendom's hero rig is 3D: keep the distance-driven gait and the layer order, but add ground contact (foot placement or IK), because the donor's feet are free sprite offsets that cannot meet a slope.
acceptance: Client test with a fixed hero rig: the same x gives the same gait phase at 30 and at 144 fps; 100 world units is exactly one walk cycle; a standing hero shows the idle pose with no step; the hammer swing reaches its last key 0.2 s after the server attack tick at any frame rate.
